title: subagent: Find Eva Draconis YouTube website link

content:
Please help me find Eva Draconis's personal website. She has a YouTube channel at youtube.com/@EvaDraconis.

Step 1: Use curl to fetch the YouTube channel page:
```
curl -sL "https://www.youtube.com/@EvaDraconis" -o /tmp/eva.html
```

Step 2: Search the HTML for any website link (look for "http" or "www" or "site" in the content):
```
grep -oi 'https\?://[^"]*' /tmp/eva.html | head -30
```

Step 3: Also try searching for any mention of "website" in the page content.

Step 4: Once you find the personal website URL, fetch it with curl and examine the top banner area.

Step 5: Identify the symbol in the top banner that has a curved line that isn't a circle or portion of a circle, and determine its meaning.

Please do all of this and report back what you find.
